blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

acceptance_requirements: MAP01 provides a reachable Isşa dialogue, sword/bow/lamp teaching, winnable training encounter, retry recovery, first upgrade, themed HUD, pause/save, and reload continuity in one route.
The actor visibly presents idle, locomotion, jump, dash, and evade states; remains grounded, camera-clear, shoulder-consistent, and equipment remains attached.
Route-boundary traversal blocks or safely recovers the player without losing objective state.
Existing movement, jump, dash, evade, shoulder switching, equipment transitions, InputMap bindings, and clean logs remain functional.
deferred_items: Host/Tester runtime recapture, formal review, and issue closure remain external responsibilities.
implied_completion: The increment must be one connected playable route rather than isolated system stubs.
Dialogue control handoff, combat retry, progression, persistence, actor states, and boundary recovery must be observable in runtime evidence.
mandatory_objectives: Close the MAP01 missing-loop blocker with a connected opening, dialogue, equipment, training combat, progression, HUD, and persistence route.
Repair the active R02 actor-state presentation and route-boundary recovery failure.
task_specification.objective: Implement one cohesive MAP01 vertical slice that connects the required narrative, equipment, combat, upgrade, HUD, pause/save, and reload flow while providing readable actor locomotion states and safe route recovery.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate is a locomotion-only bootstrap with no connected MAP01 gameplay state graph, while actor animation is static and route traversal has no safe boundary recovery.

stop_conditions: Do not expand into the deferred camera/environment issue.
Do not weaken frozen PRD acceptance when runtime evidence is unavailable; report insufficient evidence.
Stop after this single bounded increment and candidate-owned validation; Host/Tester owns replay recapture and closure.

strategy.rationale: The highest-priority failure is structural absence of the MAP01 loop, so the repair must connect the route state graph and actor presentation in one playable increment instead of repeating transform-only tuning.

code: Run native project checks and inspect scene/source transitions for dialogue, equipment, combat, upgrade, checkpoint/save, reload, actor states, and boundary recovery.
Recheck existing InputMap bindings and clean runtime logs.
runtime: Execute one fresh-run replay: spawn → Isşa dialogue → sword/bow/lamp teaching → training win or retry → first upgrade → pause/save/resume → reload → route return.
Capture runtime states for control handoff, health/damage and retry, upgrade, save/reload, each actor state, equipment attachment, and boundary recovery.
Repeat ordinary movement, jump, dash, evade, shoulder switching, and equipment transitions.
visual: Capture separated frames for authored MAP01, dialogue/HUD, combat feedback, upgraded state, and each actor locomotion state.
Verify visible pose changes, grounded traversal, camera clearance, shoulder consistency, and attached hand/back equipment.
Do not treat HUD labels, source claims, or self-reported counters as independent proof without runtime state/frame evidence.

done_when: A fresh-run same-session replay completes the MAP01 opening route from spawn through Isşa dialogue, sword/bow/lamp teaching, a winnable or retryable training encounter, first upgrade, pause/save/reload, and return to the route, while runtime frames and states show distinct idle/locomotion/jump/dash/evade actor presentation, grounded camera-clear traversal with attached equipment, and safe route-­?
tasks.instructions: Repair the candidate as one coherent MAP01 playable route. Preserve existing working movement and equipment transitions. Add the required NPC dialogue and control handoff, sword/bow/lamp teaching, training encounter with readable health/damage and retry, first upgrade, themed HUD, pause/save/reload continuity, state-driven actor presentation, grounded traversal, equipment mounts, and route-boundary recovery. Keep implementation choices open and provide candidate-bound source, runtime-state, and frame evidence for each acceptance requirement.

investigation.expected_observation: The candidate inspection will show the existing route/player/HUD bootstrap lacks NPC, enemy, dialogue, weapon, upgrade, checkpoint, and save/reload transitions, and the actor binding lacks state-specific rendered clips and boundary recovery.
investigation.hypothesis: The active failures share a structural state-graph and binding gap rather than a transform-tuning issue.
investigation.probe: Inspect main.tscn, MAP01_Locomotion.tscn, PlayerController.gd, and humanoid binding sources, then exercise one bounded spawn-to-dialogue-to-training-to-upgrade-to-reload route plus each locomotion state and a boundary attempt.

research_assessment.reason: The candidate lacks a complete loop and qualified state presentation; compare bound local resources with available authored references, consult relevant Godot scene/animation documentation, and run a bounded binding probe before implementation.
research_assessment.target_capability: Authored MAP01 environment, humanoid state animation, equipment mounts, dialogue/combat/progression/persistence integration

resource_strategy.reason: Adopt or adapt the best qualified authored map and humanoid animation resources in the bound pools, preserving semantic roles and validating import, binding, and runtime visibility before use.

risk_note.summary: The route spans several connected player-facing systems and may leave some transitions unobserved in one pass.
risk_note.validation: Replay the same fresh-run route and state matrix, capturing dialogue handoff, encounter win/retry, upgrade, save/reload, all five actor states, equipment attachment, and boundary recovery; leave any missing observation open.
risk_note.why_now: The MAP01 blocker is the highest-priority active debt and the R02 failure occurs in the same player route.
